items.desc_now: Give an AI a research direction: it runs literature synthesis, gap validation, hypothesis formation and experiment design itself. 267 markdown skills form a research graph: 51 operations built from 216 atomic steps, any order, explicit backtracking; the plan is approved before it runs and interrupted runs resume. npx install, no runtime, no API key
items.desc_prev: A 267-skill research graph in pure markdown — 51 research operations built from 216 single-purpose steps, composed in any order with explicit backtracking. One npx install, no runtime, no MCP bindings. The AI is the researcher; you set the direction.

items.desc_now: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 插件：子智能体目录按创建时间倒序；子智能体运行时自动在右侧栏打开它的会话、结束时自动关闭；子智能体失败时把真实原因交回父智能体。Subagent management bundle for the DSH Web UI.
命令在 DeepSeek Harness 里等待审批时，用 Edge / Windows 桌面通知提醒你。
DeepSeek Harness Web 界面的一小组小功能：模型菜单里的思考强度滑块、运行状态旁的实时速度与本轮用量、每条回答的输入/输出/缓存成绩单。三项各自独立开关，都只作用于界面，不改模型请求，也不上传数据。
items.desc_prev: A Codex-style effort slider, a live tokens/second and turn-total readout, and a per-answer report for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI.
